title: aphelia monogyna
intro: Aphelia monogyna, commonly known as Alder Buckthorn, is a plant species that belongs to the Elaeagnaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Aphelia monogyna include its potential to treat gastrointestinal problems, such as constipation and diarrhea, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
